title: Resonance & Commitment Lattice for company OKRs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a reproducible framework (the 'Resonance & Commitment Lattice') that maps company-level OKRs to cross-functional initiatives, exposes resource commitment signals, and produces a prioritized runway for quarterly planning. This ticket delivers a playbook, a lightweight dashboard spec for Console, and integration points for Linear/GitHub to reflect initiative resonance and commitment changes.
acceptance_criteria: A playbook doc describing the Lattice concept + step-by-step for PMs and ENG leads (Confluence link included)
A Console dashboard prototype that shows OKR-to-initiative mapping, commitment heat (FTE and GPU-hours), and a 6-week runway view
Two end-to-end example mappings completed for Revenue Enablement and Dedicated Capacity initiatives, with owners and resource commitments recorded
A lightweight CSV import/export and a Linear label convention so teams can tag initiatives that feed the Lattice
Stakeholder sign-off from Eng, Design, and GTM on prioritization heuristics and escalation rules
tasks: Define Lattice vocabulary and prioritization heuristics (effort, impact, risk, customer exposure)
Prototype dashboard wireframes with Design (Figma) and iterate with Engineering on data sources
Instrument Console to surface commitment signals (capacity reserves, commit windows, cost delta) — engineering spec
Create Linear tag schema and automation to surface candidate initiatives into the Lattice
Run two pilot sessions with initiative owners and capture feedback for the playbook
Publish the playbook and host a 90-minute training for PM/Eng leads

notes: Decision: use a 4-factor scoring model (impact, effort, risk, customer exposure) with tunable weights per cycle. Agreed to default weights: impact 40, effort 25, risk 20, exposure 15.
Trade-off: detailed resource modeling improves fidelity but increases data collection burden. For MVP we will accept coarse bands (Low/Medium/High) for GPU and FTE commitments.
Follow-up: Investigate integrating Redwood Console cost-per-route queries into the Lattice for next quarter if prototype shows value (owner: Eng Observability team).
Design constraint: prioritize readability for exec review — show top 6 initiatives that 'resonate' with company OKRs and a separate view for 'at-risk' commitments.
